summary.zh: 危險訊號 10 檔多於偏多 2 檔，UNH 重挫 10.21% 並跌破 200 日線
summary.en: 10 warning signals vs 2 bullish; UNH fell 10.21% and broke below its 200-day MA

text.zh: COST 出現 50／200 日線黃金交叉，均線多頭排列，RSI 69.2 接近 70 過熱線
text.en: COST: 50/200-day golden cross, MAs in bullish alignment; RSI 69.2 near the 70 overbought line

text.zh: TSLA 收盤突破 200 日線，但 MACD 仍偏空、均線盤整，RSI 51.1
text.en: TSLA closed above its 200-day MA, but MACD is still bearish and MAs are range-bound; RSI 51.1

text.zh: AMZN 上漲 3.82%，MACD 偏多、均線多頭排列，RSI 57.2
text.en: AMZN rose 3.82%; MACD bullish, MAs in bullish alignment, RSI 57.2

text.zh: LLY 均線維持多頭排列，但 MACD 轉為偏空，RSI 56.2
text.en: LLY: MAs remain in bullish alignment but MACD is bearish; RSI 56.2

text.zh: XLE 下跌 3.27%，MACD 偏空、均線盤整，RSI 36.9 偏低
text.en: XLE fell 3.27%; MACD bearish, MAs range-bound, RSI 36.9 on the low side

text.zh: UNH 單日下跌 10.21%，RSI 急轉直下並跌破 200 日線，長期趨勢轉弱
text.en: UNH dropped 10.21% in one day; RSI plunged and it broke below the 200-day MA, long-term trend weakening

text.zh: BRK-B、JNJ 同時出現 MACD 死亡交叉與 RSI 急轉直下
text.en: BRK-B and JNJ both show a MACD death cross plus a sharp RSI drop

text.zh: JPM RSI 急轉直下並跌破布林下軌；GLD 下跌 3.2% 跌破布林下軌
text.en: JPM: sharp RSI drop and a break below the lower Bollinger Band; GLD fell 3.2% and broke below its lower band

text.zh: 006208.TW 跌破 200 日線；XLV RSI 急轉直下
text.en: 006208.TW broke below its 200-day MA; XLV saw a sharp RSI drop

text.zh: GS、MCD、XLP 出現 MACD 死亡交叉，防禦與金融類股動能同步轉弱
text.en: GS, MCD and XLP show MACD death crosses; momentum fading in both defensives and financials

text.zh: 僅 2 檔出現偏多訊號：COST 黃金交叉、TSLA 突破 200 日線，皆為關注股票
text.en: Only 2 bullish signals: COST golden cross and TSLA above its 200-day MA, both on the watch list

summary.zh: 中東衝突與川普亞洲行為主要焦點，WMT 今日盤前公布財報
summary.en: Middle East conflict and Trump's Asia trip lead the news; WMT reports before today's open

text.zh: 胡塞組織飛彈威脅利雅德並造成損害，沙國稍後表示南部三城危險已解除
text.en: Houthi missile threat toward Riyadh caused damage; Saudi Arabia later said danger had passed in three southern cities

text.zh: 油價持穩：供給過剩壓抑氣氛，但波斯灣戰事提供支撐
text.en: Oil prices steady: supply surplus weighs on sentiment while the Gulf war offers support

text.zh: 川普亞洲行第二天，稱與習近平、普丁的峰會在舉行前就已是「勝利」
text.en: Day 2 of Trump's Asia tour; he called the summit with Xi and Putin a 'win' before it began

text.zh: 以色列在加薩中部展開地面行動；Orlen 傳與 QatarEnergy 洽談新 LNG 合約
text.en: Israel launched a ground operation in central Gaza; Orlen reportedly in talks with QatarEnergy on a new LNG deal

text.zh: COST：一項節慶熱門食品召回；科技斷線引發發電機搶購而售罄
text.en: COST: recall of a popular holiday food item; generators sold out amid panic purchases after tech outages

text.zh: AMZN：報導指其對 Anthropic 的 180 億美元投資以 IPO 價計約值 1590 億美元
text.en: AMZN: report says its $18B Anthropic stake is worth $159B at the IPO price

text.zh: LLY：併購總額超過 320 億美元；加拿大核准 Mounjaro 用於降低心血管風險
text.en: LLY: acquisitions surpass $32B; Health Canada approved Mounjaro to reduce cardiovascular risk

text.zh: TSLA：馬斯克談 Tesla 與 SpaceX 合作，並評論 Nvidia 更換執行長黃仁勳
text.en: TSLA: Musk discussed Tesla and SpaceX working together and commented on Nvidia replacing CEO Jensen Huang

text.zh: XLE：類股更新指能源股午後走低
text.en: XLE: sector updates say energy stocks fell in afternoon trading

text.zh: WMT 預計 11/19 盤前公布財報，EPS 預估 0.6421
text.en: WMT is expected to report before the open on 11/19; EPS estimate 0.6421

summary.zh: TSLA 本益比 421.67 倍居首，NVDA、GOOGL 接近 52 週低點
summary.en: TSLA leads with a 421.67 P/E; NVDA and GOOGL sit near 52-week lows

text.zh: 本益比最高：TSLA 421.67、AMD 113.28、PLTR 110.33 倍
text.en: Highest P/E: TSLA 421.67, AMD 113.28, PLTR 110.33

text.zh: 關注股 COST 本益比 52.82、LLY 44.88、AMZN 21.64 倍
text.en: Watch list: COST P/E 52.82, LLY 44.88, AMZN 21.64
Highest yields: 006208.TW 5.7%, BND 4.17%, SGOV 3.63%

text.zh: VNQ 3.58%、CVX 3.46% 緊隨其後
text.en: VNQ at 3.58% and CVX at 3.46% follow

text.zh: NVDA 距 52 週高點 -37.97%，僅高於低點 1.45%
text.en: NVDA is 37.97% below its 52-week high and only 1.45% above its low

text.zh: GLD 距 52 週高點 -33.06%，幾乎貼近低點（+0.13%）
text.en: GLD is 33.06% below its 52-week high, nearly at its low (+0.13%)

text.zh: GOOGL 距 52 週高點 -30.79%，距低點 3.93%
text.en: GOOGL is 30.79% below its 52-week high and 3.93% above its low

text.zh: 接近 52 週高點：PG -1.9%、AAPL -2.32%、COST -2.41%
text.en: Near 52-week highs: PG -1.9%, AAPL -2.32%, COST -2.41%

summary.zh: 多方看半導體反彈與防禦股強勢，空方看市場廣度弱與台股恐慌
summary.en: Bulls see a chip rebound and strong defensives; bears cite weak breadth and a panicky Taiwan market

text.zh: AMD 漲 5.31%、AVGO 漲 3.64%，QQQ 當日上漲 0.39%，科技股出現反彈
text.en: AMD +5.31% and AVGO +3.64%; QQQ rose 0.39% on the day as tech bounced

text.zh: COST 黃金交叉、TSLA 突破 200 日線，個別股票仍有轉強訊號
text.en: COST golden cross and TSLA back above its 200-day MA show pockets of strength

text.zh: PG、AAPL、COST 距 52 週高點都在 2.5% 以內，部分股票仍接近高檔
text.en: PG, AAPL and COST are all within 2.5% of 52-week highs

text.zh: NVDA 預估本益比 9.09、GOOGL 本益比 14.75，估值已明顯降溫
text.en: NVDA forward P/E is 9.09 and GOOGL's P/E is 14.75; valuations have cooled markedly

text.zh: 上漲 17 家、下跌 31 家，上漲比例僅約 35%，市場廣度偏弱
text.en: 17 up vs 31 down, only about 35% advancing; market breadth is weak

text.zh: VOO 處於「修正下跌」狀態 14 天，20 日報酬 -5.5%；QQQ 30 天跌 11.78%
text.en: VOO has been in a 'correction' regime for 14 days, 20-day return -5.5%; QQQ is down 11.78% over 30 days
0050 is in a 'high-volatility (panic)' regime: 20-day vol 43.5%, drawdown -19.3%

text.zh: 危險訊號 10 檔遠多於偏多 2 檔，UNH 單日重挫 10.21%
text.en: 10 warning signals far outnumber 2 bullish ones; UNH plunged 10.21% in one day

summary.zh: 美股修正、台股恐慌，市場廣度弱，留意危險訊號擴散
summary.en: US in correction, Taiwan in panic, breadth weak; warning signals are spreading

text.zh: 市場狀態偏弱：VOO「修正下跌」14 天，0050「高波動（恐慌）」，回檔 -19.3%
text.en: Regimes are weak: VOO in 'correction' for 14 days; 0050 in 'high-volatility (panic)' with a -19.3% drawdown

text.zh: 廣度偏弱：上漲 17 家、下跌 31 家；危險訊號 10 檔、偏多僅 2 檔
text.en: Breadth is weak: 17 up vs 31 down; 10 warning signals vs only 2 bullish

text.zh: UNH 重挫 10.21% 跌破 200 日線；醫療、金融、黃金多檔同時轉弱
text.en: UNH plunged 10.21% below its 200-day MA; several healthcare, financial and gold names weakened together

text.zh: 半導體反彈（AMD +5.31%、AVGO +3.64%），但 NVDA 仍貼近 52 週低點
text.en: Chips bounced (AMD +5.31%, AVGO +3.64%), yet NVDA remains near its 52-week low

text.zh: 今日焦點：WMT 盤前財報，以及中東局勢與油價變化
text.en: Today's focus: WMT earnings before the open, plus Middle East tensions and oil prices
